title: Among male patients with both an abnormal IgM level and an abnormal lactate
question: Among male patients with both an abnormal IgM level and an abnormal lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) level, find the oldest patient whose total cholesterol (T-CHO) is within the normal range. Return their ID, sex, age, LDH value, IgM value, and total cholesterol level.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_059", T1."XCL_060", T2."XCL_018", T2."XCL_044", T2."XCL_026"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T2."XCL_044" NOT BETWEEN 40 AND 400
  AND T2."XCL_018" > 500
  AND T2."XCL_026" < 250
ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 1
